d:
Immerse yourself in the soulful melody of ‘Nyabagam’, from the movie ‘Varshangalkku Shesham’. This song has been composed by Amrit Ramnath with beautiful lyrics penned by Bombay Jayashri. Amrit Ramnath and Sindoora Jishnu have lent their soothing voices to this song, taking one on a mesmerising, nostalgic journey through this composition.
Song Credits:
Song Name : Nyabagam
Movie : Varshangalkku Shesham
Composed, Produced, Arranged by Amrit Ramnath
Lyrics by Bombay Jayashri
Vocals by Amrit Ramnath, Sindoora Jishnu
Strings Arranged by Amrit Ramnath and Rithu Vysakh
